episodes.title: The Cult of Stalin and the 1936 Constitution | Year 13 A Level History
episodes.description:
Was Stalin's 1936 Constitution democratic, or a mask? This lesson looks at how the Stalin cult was built, what the constitution promised, and what happened in practice.

Cambridge International A Level History (9489), Paper 4, Stalin's Russia, 1924-41: 2.2 How effectively did Stalin govern the Soviet Union?

By the end you can:
- Describe how the Stalin cult was built and what it was for.
- Explain what the 1936 Constitution promised and what happened in practice.
- Judge how effective cult and constitution were as tools of government.

Includes think-pauses and a short debate. Narrated with a synthetic British English voice. Made by Elsie Eayrs for IWS Year 13 History students.
